content_zh:
已经到的三人都来自不同省份。晚上棠雪回寝室，和赵芹叶柳莺聊天, 说到各自的专业，另外两人听说她是被调剂到兽医的，都安慰她, 说兽医专业毕业以后的出路很好的, 做宠物医生，开宠物医院, 进动物保护组织, 都是不错的选择呢。棠雪听着, 心想怎么别人的思路都这么洋气, 我爹净想着给母猪催奶了？他老人家到底经历过什么？
这晚棠雪带着对未来的美好憧憬进入梦乡, 第二天早上醒来时, 发现寝室里多了一个人。
此人身高一米六左右，瘦瘦的，肤色苍白, 一头深褐色的长发披在肩上, 随着她的动作，堆在肩头的柔软发丝像水波一样轻微晃动。
她这会儿刚进门，把两个大行李箱拖进来，一扭头，看到趴在床上盯着她看的棠雪。她朝棠雪笑了笑：“你好哦。”
语气好温柔啊。
棠雪都快化了，连忙起身说道：“你好你好，你就是夏梦欢吧？我还以为你不来了呢。”
“我家离这不远，昨天没来。”
四个室友正式会师，赵芹指了指夏梦欢的大箱子，问：“你自己提过来的？”
“不是，路上遇到了好心人。”
“我怎么遇不到好心人，一定是因为你漂亮。”
“这个，如果你遇到男人，不管高矮胖瘦老少美丑，只要喊他一声‘帅哥’，他多半会成为好心人的。”
棠雪觉得这个夏梦欢讲话蛮好玩的。她看了眼时间，貌似来不及吃早饭了，于是给廖振羽打了个电话。
棠雪：“帅哥。”
廖振羽：“……！！！”
棠雪：“帅哥~~~”
“老大你怎么了？你别这样，我害怕……你还是叫我小廖、小羽子吧，实在不行叫‘贱货’也成……”
棠雪扶了一下额，“别废话了，给我捎点早饭。”
“喳。”
廖振羽昨天充话费送了一辆自行车，自行车的外形走卖萌路线，很小的一只，廖振羽身材高大，骑这么一辆自行车像是骑着一头小绵羊飞奔，画面不忍直视。
他骑着羊停在农学院教学楼的门口，把早餐递给棠雪。

夏梦欢站在棠雪身边，饶有兴致地打量着他，然后悄悄问棠雪：“男朋友？”
声音故意压低，还是被廖振羽听到了。他朝夏梦欢勾了勾手指，“同学，你过来一下。”
“哈？”夏梦欢走近了一些。
廖振羽一脸严肃：“看着的我眼睛。”
夏梦欢莫名其妙，但还是照做。
廖振羽：“我瞎吗？”
“……”
棠雪本来在研究早餐都有什么，听到这话，她飞起一脚作势要踢他。廖振羽脚下发力一蹬，骑上小绵羊窜出去了，速度有如疯狗。
留下一句话飘在风中：“老大，午饭一起吃！”
棠雪和夏梦欢一起上课时，看到夏梦欢写的字清秀漂亮，字如其人，加上她瘦弱苍白的外表，讲话时温柔的语气神态，棠雪就觉得这是一个柔弱清纯的妹子。
这个印象维持了大概四个多小时，直到午饭时间。
午饭时夏梦欢买了一根烤肠和两颗香芋丸子，她把烤肠放在盘子中间，香芋丸子放在烤肠的一端，分局两侧。
这造型，在生物课本里也有。
棠雪的下巴差点掉下来。
廖振羽坐在棠雪身边，偷偷给棠雪发微信。
廖振羽：老大，你室友好像是个流氓耶？
棠雪：你闭嘴。
廖振羽：我没有张嘴，我只是在打字。
廖振羽：老大我现在比较担心你的安全了。
廖振羽：啊我在害怕什么，我老大可是流氓头子耶，还能怕这个小流氓？

棠雪：= =
棠雪重重踩了他一脚，他终于消停了。
棠雪感觉夏梦欢应该是不小心这样子的，于是悄悄提醒她。
棠雪：欢妹，你盘子里有个小JJ！
夏梦欢：不是小JJ，是大JJ。(＾－＾)V
棠雪：……
这个故事告诉我们，人就应该多读书，上大学。等上了大学，你一定会看到一个更广阔的天地，更神奇的世界。
吃完饭，棠雪他们在食堂外边的公告墙上看到一份招聘启事。公告墙上贴着那么多花花绿绿的公告，一个个像是青楼小姐姐们抖的花手绢，恨不得使出浑身解数吸引看客的注意力。唯有角落里那份招聘启事，A4纸打印，仿宋体，黑底白字，简单干净，与周围的花花世界格格不入。

content_en:
The three people who have arrived are from different provinces. In the evening, Tangxue went back to the dormitory and chatted with Zhao Qin and Ye Liuying. They talked about their respective majors. The other two heard that she was transferred to a veterinarian, and they comforted her, saying that the future after graduating from the veterinary major was very good. Becoming a pet doctor, opening a pet hospital, or joining an animal protection organization were all good choices. Tangxue listened and thought to herself, why are other people's ideas so Western? Is my father just thinking about inducing lactation for sows? What has this old man experienced?
That night, Tangxue fell asleep with a beautiful vision for the future. When she woke up the next morning, she found that there was an extra person in the dormitory.
This person is about 1.6 meters tall, thin, with pale skin, and has long dark brown hair draped over her shoulders. As she moves, the soft hair piled on her shoulders sways slightly like water waves.
She had just walked in and dragged two large suitcases in. When she turned around, she saw Tang Xue lying on the bed staring at her. She smiled at Tangxue and said, "Hello."
The tone is so gentle.
Tangxue almost melted, and she quickly stood up and said, "Hello, hello, are you Xia Menghuan, right? I thought you weren't coming."
"My home is not far from here. I didn't come yesterday."
The four roommates formally met. Zhao Qin pointed to Xia Menghuan's big box and asked, "Did you carry it here yourself?"
"No, I met some kind-hearted people on the road."
"Why can't I meet kind-hearted people? It must be because you are beautiful."
"Well, if you meet a man, no matter tall, short, fat, skinny, old or young, beautiful or ugly, just call him 'handsome guy' and he will probably become a kind person."
Tang Xue found Xia Menghuan's speech quite amusing. She looked at the time and saw that it was too late to have breakfast, so she called Liao Zhenyu.
Tang Xue: "Handsome guy."
Liao Zhenyu: "...!!!"
Tangxue: "Handsome guy~~~"
"Boss, what's wrong with you? Don't be like this, I'm afraid... You should just call me Xiao Liao or Xiao Yuzi. If you can't, you can just call me 'bitch'..."
Tangxue held her forehead and said, "Stop talking nonsense and bring me some breakfast."
"Cha."
Yesterday, Liao Zhenyu paid for a bicycle as a gift. The bicycle has a very cute appearance. It is very small. Liao Zhenyu is tall. Riding such a bicycle is like riding a little sheep and the picture is unbearable.
He rode his sheep and stopped at the door of the teaching building of the Agricultural College and handed his breakfast to Tang Xue.
Xia Menghuan stood next to Tang Xue, looking at him with interest, and then quietly asked Tang Xue: "Boyfriend?"
The voice was deliberately lowered, but Liao Zhenyu still heard it. He raised his fingers towards Xia Menghuan and said, "Classmate, come here."
"Huh?" Xia Menghuan walked closer.
Liao Zhenyu looked serious: "Look into my eyes."
Xia Menghuan was baffled, but still did as he was told.
Liao Zhenyu: "Am I blind?"
"..."
Tang Xue was studying what was for breakfast. When she heard this, she flew up and tried to kick him. Liao Zhenyu kicked his feet hard, mounted the little sheep and ran out, as fast as a mad dog.
He left a sentence floating in the wind: "Boss, let's have lunch together!"
When Tang Xue and Xia Menghuan were in class together, she saw that Xia Menghuan's handwriting was delicate and beautiful, and her words were just like her person. Coupled with her thin and pale appearance, and her gentle tone and demeanor when speaking, Tang Xue felt that she was a weak and pure girl.
This impression lasted for about four hours, until lunch time.
During lunch, Xia Menghuan bought a grilled sausage and two taro balls. She placed the grilled sausage in the middle of the plate and placed the taro balls at one end of the grilled sausage, on both sides.
This shape is also found in biology textbooks.
Tangxue's jaw almost dropped.
Liao Zhenyu sat next to Tang Xue and secretly sent Tang Xue a WeChat message.
Liao Zhenyu: Boss, your roommate seems to be a gangster?
Tangxue: Shut up.
Liao Zhenyu: I didn’t open my mouth, I was just typing.
Liao Zhenyu: I’m here, bossI'm more worried about your safety.
Liao Zhenyu: Oh, what am I afraid of? My boss is a gangster leader. How can I be afraid of this little gangster?
Tang Xue: = =
Tangxue stepped on him hard and he finally stopped.
Tangxue felt that Xia Menghuan must have acted like this accidentally, so she reminded her quietly.
Tangxue: Huanmei, you have a little penis on your plate!
Xia Menghuan: It’s not a little JJ, it’s a big JJ. (＾－＾)V
Tangxue:......
This story tells us that people should study more and go to college. When you go to college, you will definitely see a broader world and a more magical world.
After eating, Tangxue and the others saw a recruitment notice on the bulletin wall outside the cafeteria. There are so many colorful announcements posted on the bulletin wall, each one is like the flower handkerchiefs shaken by the ladies in a brothel, trying their best to attract the attention of the onlookers. There is only the recruitment notice in the corner, printed on A4 paper, imitation Song font, with white characters on a black background. It is simple and clean, and is incompatible with the colorful world around it.
